## v1.0.0-alpha.2

[The documentation at this tag](https://github.com/brunovenceslau/romeu-e-julieta/tree/v1.0.0-alpha.2/docs).

### Upgrading

- Error ids added: `RJ-103` unlisted-host (exit 1).
- Exit codes changed: `RJ-102` drift (exit 2 to 3).
- Format versions changed: ProjectVersion 1 to 2.
- Kits whose projects need a recreate: julieta.

### Breaking changes

- spec: the host settings gain a field ([#4](https://github.com/brunovenceslau/romeu-e-julieta/issues/4))

  The field was missing.

- sync: gate 2 refuses an unlisted host ([#3](https://github.com/brunovenceslau/romeu-e-julieta/issues/3))

  An unlisted host passed.

### Features

- doctor: the gh-floor row ([#6](https://github.com/brunovenceslau/romeu-e-julieta/issues/6))

  The floor is checked. See [#12](https://github.com/brunovenceslau/romeu-e-julieta/issues/12) and [#6](https://github.com/brunovenceslau/romeu-e-julieta/issues/6).
